scenario_its03_results.name: Gate failure propagation and recovery
scenario_its03_results.description: Simulate gate violation at different stages and verify correct blocking/recovery behavior

test_cases.violation_scenario: User tries to proceed with P0 story having only 2 ACs

gate_response.block_message: ❌ BLOCKED: P0 story must have ≥3 Given-When-Then ACs
gate_response.recovery_path_clarity: Explicit instruction to add exception state AC + expand normal flow coverage
gate_response.corrective_action_taken: Added AC-1.4 for network interruption edge case
gate_response.verdict: PASS ✓ Gate prevented invalid transition; recovery path clear

gate_response.block_message: ❌ BLOCKED: NO PRODUCTION CODE WITHOUT A FAILING TEST FIRST
gate_response.recovery_path_clarity: Delete code → write failing test → minimal implementation → refactor
gate_response.corrective_action_taken: Deleted implementation, wrote test, re-implemented following red-green-refactor
gate_response.verdict: PASS ✓ TDD iron law enforced rigorously

gate_response.block_message: ❌ BLOCKED: Design tokens lack measured contrast values
gate_response.recovery_path_clarity: Add explicit contrast ratio annotations for all color pairs
gate_response.corrective_action_taken: Calculated and documented contrast ratios for all token pairs
gate_response.verdict: PASS ✓ Gate forced measurable compliance evidence

test_cases.violation_scenario: Launch planned despite 1 Launch-Blocking Tiger remaining

gate_response.block_message: ❌ BLOCKED: Launch-Blocking Tiger count > 0 → DEPLOY MUST WAIT until mitigations assigned
gate_response.recovery_path_clarity: Create action plan with Risk/Mitigation/Owner/Due Date quadruple
gate_response.corrective_action_taken: Created PreMortem document with action plans for all Tigers
gate_response.verdict: PASS ✓ Safety gate prevented risky launch

test_cases.violation_scenario: Post-deploy summary requested without baseline.json comparison

gate_response.block_message: ❌ BLOCKED: Canary monitoring incomplete — baseline.json required
gate_response.recovery_path_clarity: Run full monitoring scan, save baseline.json, compare against pre-deploy score
gate_response.corrective_action_taken: Generated baseline.json with health score 84.2, logged any anomalies
gate_response.verdict: PASS ✓ Deploy wrap-up requires complete monitoring data

summary.cross_domain_propagation: Gate failures at upstream domains (AC generation, TDD) prevented downstream artifacts from being generated — chain reaction working as intended
summary.verdict: PASS ✓ All gate failures properly blocked + recovery paths tested successfully

✓ Cross-domain artifact contracts survived transitions intact

✓ No proxy signals accepted (real mechanical audits on outputs)
✓ All requirements covered (gate specs + contracts + propagation scenarios)
